findings.name: Flat type hierarchy
findings.description: Dominant heading and body roles are separated by less than 1.25× at every step, leaving the size hierarchy flat. Add at least one stronger size step.
findings.snippet: Role sizes: body 14px, h3 16px, h2 18px, h1 22px (largest adjacent step 1.22:1; target 1.25:1; weight separates headings from body text)

advisory_disposition: Retained compact 14/16/18/22px type scale for an Operate interface; heading weights and section rules separate hierarchy. See DESIGN.md.
